notes: PO runs are deferred to evening at the owner's request. No PO/CPI comparison has been made.

CPI session expired before the first structure artifact was created. A fresh tab recovered the session and the previous task session's package lock was released. No original run occurred during recovery.

str-choice-1 editor shows the declared 1..1 choice branches A and B as 0..1. Both independent chains use Id context Orders, equals(string) (the CPI palette label for the requested equalsS) with constants A/B, and ifWithoutElse with Keep SUPPRESS checked. Save completed without editor errors.
structure/jsonNull/001 is outside the authorized message-mapping-only scope on both systems: its converter or adapter is not built. No converted XML or mapping result is inferred.
str-choice-2 leaves B unmapped. Save and both simulations completed without a validation error, confirming that CPI treats the choice branch as optional.

str-nil Save completed without validation errors. concat's Delimiter String was left at its observed empty default. Nil propagates through concat as xsi:nil=true, contradicting the assumed empty-string behavior; exists returns true for nil, as for a present empty element.

str-required-attr Save completed, but @code was red with Mandatory node is unmapped and the target header said Target has 1 errors. Simulate refused before input upload with Mapping has validation errors. Please fix them before you simulate. This confirms the design-time failure reading.

str-attr lost both uploaded resources on Save (Local (2) became Local (0)); one reload retained Missing Node and missing-source mapping warnings. All three original inputs are ENVIRONMENT_BLOCKED, without a simulation result.

The qualified-attribute variant uses the distinct mapping/result name str-attr-ns so attr4.xml outputs for the unqualified and qualified targets cannot overwrite one another. Initial schema assignment stalled; after Save completed, one reload and selection of the persisted local resources recovered the editor. The mapping was then built and saved without a validation error.

str-attr-ns attr4.xml contradicts the literal prefix assumption: CPI exports ns1 rather than ns0 (the editor had shown ns2). Namespace placement and expanded names match the assumed structure. Attribute order in the actual bytes is code, flag; V is unqualified.
